# jev-crawlers

Small unix tools for bug-discovery, powered by Jev. One tool, one job,
JSON lines on stdin/stdout, composed with pipes. Jev learns a repo's
decision norms, then adversarially judges past decisions against them.

- Repo: https://github.com/Thingscorp/jev-crawlers
- Docs: https://github.com/Thingscorp/jev-crawlers#readme

## Tools (`bin/`)

`crawl` (orchestrator) · `jev-seed.mjs` · `jev-expand.mjs` ·
`jev-judge.mjs` · `jev-verify.mjs` · `jev-report.mjs` · `jev-verdict.mjs`

```sh
./bin/crawl --repo ./my-app --dry-run --budget 8   # no key needed
```

## Configuration

`--api-key` flag → `$AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` → `api_key=` in
`~/.config/jev-crawlers/config`. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 runtime error,
2 usage/config error. `--help` on every tool; `--json` for machine output.
